description: HomeFragment.kt is an Android Fragment implementation serving as the main home screen in an Android TV application. It manages UI components including a hero banner carousel, 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' sections, integrates with a ViewModel for data, and handles focus navigation, including D-pad control, auto-scrolling, and focus gating. The code utilizes Jetpack Compose for a top navigation bar within a traditional View hierarchy and features detailed layout and interaction logic tailored for TV interfaces.

classes.name: HomeFragment
